verdicts.reason: A pushes the 'Build Your Mix' CTA and all five ingredient chips into a cramped top-left cluster jammed against the edge, where the CTA is a tiny pill no bigger than the chips. The logo is shoved right inside the moon circle, the legal line sits directly under the headline, and the bottom third is dead space. B keeps the logo centred at the top and the headline → product → chips order, but the CTA is shrunk to a chip-sized pill with even tinier text and buried among the ingredients. The chips also come in two different sizes across rows with an awkward gap between them, and the fine print still sits right under the headline instead of at the foot.
